gaps.quote: So adding them does not change asymptotic bounds
gaps.note: The referent of "them" is not stated anywhere on the page; the page never says what is added to the machine, so the reader cannot check the claim that adding them leaves asymptotic bounds unchanged. The sentence is cited, but the page does not say what the cited result states or why it applies here.

The sentence is cut off before saying what the paper does instead of moving blocks across long distances. The page never states the alternative method, so the reader cannot know what role the citation plays in the page's argument.

gaps.term: return of the heads after the shift
gaps.quote: One more scan returns the heads.
gaps.note: The page does not say where the heads are after the shifting pass or why a single further scan brings every head back to its start, so the one-extra-pass cost cannot be checked from the page.

gaps.term: fields as streams for cell-wise XOR
gaps.quote: Applied cell by cell to two equal-width streams
gaps.note: The page defines fields and streams separately but never says that the contents of the two fields are laid out as two streams with corresponding cells. The reader cannot check that the cell-by-cell three-pass XOR exchanges the fields in every address.
